public_rationale: On the ordinary reading of no measurable progress, contemporary evaluations contradict the claim. GPT-4's report documents improved TruthfulQA performance, and GenEval finds compositional gains across successive image models. These results coexist with serious failures: GenEval still finds spatial relations and attribute binding difficult, and NewsGuard reports persistent misinformation problems. A narrower claim that the problems remained unsolved would be compatible with the evidence.
limitations: The verdict depends on reading progress as measurable improvement rather than complete resolution.
The factuality comparison is company-reported; OpenAI did not check its RLHF data for TruthfulQA contamination.
Benchmarks cover selected tasks and do not establish reliable performance in every setting.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI has made no progress on factuality and compositionality since 2022, despite progress in other respects.

statement.excerpt: In some ways we have made progress, but in the ones I keep harping on—factuality and compositionality—we have not.

from_speaker: In some ways we have made progress
our_interpretation: The surrounding retrospective supplies May 2022 as the starting point and February 13, 2024 as the endpoint.
The ordinary reading is no measurable improvement in factual accuracy or in combining requested objects, attributes, and relations correctly.
Progress does not require eliminating hallucinations or solving every compositional task.
Comparable evaluations showing meaningful gains within this interval can contradict the categorical claim; they need not establish improvement on every task.
The broad wording covers generative AI, not only the horse-and-astronaut prompt.
criteria.support_condition: Broad comparable evaluations show no meaningful gains in either factual accuracy or compositional performance over the period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible comparable evaluations document meaningful improvements in factuality or compositionality during the period.

evidence.explanation: The report compares factual accuracy on TruthfulQA and reports gains over earlier models. This contradicts a categorical absence of factuality progress, subject to the company's evaluation methods and contamination caveat.

evidence.publisher: Dhruba Ghosh, Hanna Hajishirzi, and Ludwig Schmidt via arXiv
evidence.explanation: The same benchmark reports higher compositional scores for newer models: overall scores rise from 0.43 for SDv1.5 to 0.55 for SD-XL and 0.61 for IF-XL. Position and attribute binding also improve while remaining difficult.

evidence.locator: Paragraph reporting the August 2023 repeat audit
evidence.explanation: This audit documents severe persistent misinformation failures and reports no improvement over six months on its narrower test. It limits any claim of universal progress, but does not erase gains on other factuality or compositional evaluations.
